source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The added UidsFromHdrs body calls MOZ_ASSERT(key != nsMsgKey_None) without an explicit message. The same call remains in the inspected fixed implementation. Under the current user-directed assertion rule, this changed site needs a nonempty message stating that the message header should have a valid key. This scoped finding is separate from older formatter assertions, unchanged caller assertions and any runtime failure.
title: The new header-to-UID assertion has no explicit expected-result message
